name: model-guard
description: Choose the model versions Claude and its subagents may use: /models lists the newest of each family from Anthropic's Models API (older versions one key away); block a version, or a family's new ones, and subagents, workflows and /model asking for it are refused or moved to an allowed version. One list shared by every Claude Code window on the machine; a repo can keep its own.

defaultAllowed.title: Allowed by default
defaultAllowed.description: Seeds the global list on the first 0.3 session (the 0.2 setting), and stands in when the saved lists can't be read: comma-separated families allowed (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, other). Otherwise change things in /models.

fallback.title: Fallback model
fallback.description: Seeds the global list (and fills a 0.2 repo choice that had none): where requests on a blocked version go when their family has nothing allowed. Otherwise /models (f).

mode.title: Explicit asks for a blocked version
mode.description: Seeds the global list (and fills a 0.2 repo choice that had none). deny: refuse the spawn so Claude picks again; swap: run it on an allowed version. Otherwise /models (m).
